faqs.question: Which ITM institution is this?
faqs.answer: This is ITM University in Gwalior, Madhya Pradesh, with its official address on NH-44, Jhansi Road.

faqs.question: How long are the two listed courses?
faqs.answer: The bachelor’s degree is four years; the agronomy master’s is described as two years.

faqs.question: What practical resource is described in the brochure?
faqs.answer: The agriculture school’s brochure identifies an instructional farm.

faqs.question: Why should agronomy applicants confirm eligibility?
faqs.answer: The course page, FAQ and central table use different qualifying-degree and marks wording.

faqs.question: Are the placement figures from the whole university?
faqs.answer: The figures here are from the agriculture-and-allied NIRF return, grouped by programme length; they are not a B.Sc.-only outcome.

faqs.question: What is the ICAR term for the listed programmes?
faqs.answer: The audited record runs from 29 July 2024 to 28 July 2029 and includes B.Sc. Agriculture and M.Sc. Agronomy.

faqs.question: Which agriculture or allied programmes are covered at ITM University?
faqs.answer: This profile covers B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture; M.Sc. (Ag.) Agronomy. The [courses and fees table](/university/itm-university-gwalior/course-fee) separates the qualifications and published fee periods.

faqs.question: How long is B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at ITM University?
faqs.answer: 4 years. A broad degree moving from agricultural foundations toward production and skills work.

faqs.question: How long is M.Sc. (Ag.) Agronomy at ITM University?
faqs.answer: 2 years. A postgraduate route focused on agronomy, listed separately by the school.

faqs.question: What are the entry requirements for B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at ITM University?
faqs.answer: Central table: 10+2 Science/Agriculture with at least 50%; the course page names PCMB, PCB, PCM or Agriculture subjects.

faqs.question: What are the entry requirements for M.Sc. (Ag.) Agronomy at ITM University?
faqs.answer: Course page states B.Sc. Agriculture/Honours with minimum 5.5 CGPA; its FAQ also includes horticulture, while the central table states 50% in agriculture stream. Confirm the current governing rule.

faqs.question: What fee is documented for B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture at ITM University?
faqs.answer: A verified numerical fee is not available. An academic-year-specific official fee schedule for this programme was not verified.

faqs.question: What fee is documented for M.Sc. (Ag.) Agronomy at ITM University?
faqs.answer: A verified numerical fee is not available. An academic-year-specific official fee schedule for this programme was not verified.

faqs.question: How does admission to ITM University work?
faqs.answer: The central eligibility page and individual course pages provide useful entry information. The agronomy pages use differing marks/qualification wording, so applicants should obtain the applying-year rule in writing. Match the degree-level entry rule: Check the bachelor’s science/agriculture requirement or the master’s qualifying-degree rule. Resolve the master’s eligibility wording: Ask admissions to confirm which current minimum and accepted degree apply to M.Sc. Agronomy.

faqs.question: What is the recorded ICAR scope for ITM University?
faqs.answer: ITM University, Gwalior: B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture (Intake- 240); M.Sc. (Ag) Agronomy (intake 10), recorded term 2024-07-29 to 2029-07-28. This entry applies to the named unit and programme.

faqs.question: What practical learning is described at ITM University?
faqs.answer: The bachelor’s page describes Student READY work and skill-oriented progression.

faqs.question: Which teaching facilities are documented at ITM University?
faqs.answer: Instructional farm: A teaching farm is described in the school’s brochure. Agronomy and plant protection laboratories: The agronomy page lists agronomy, entomology and plant pathology laboratories. Agricultural engineering workshop: A workshop appears among the programme’s practical resources.

faqs.question: What student facilities are documented for ITM University?
faqs.answer: The brochure identifies an instructional farm and laboratory resources; the programme pages identify agronomy, crop protection and other subject spaces. Accommodation availability, meal charges and transport arrangements for your entry year still need direct confirmation.

faqs.question: What scholarship information is available for ITM University?
faqs.answer: ITM’s 2026 policy describes merit, sports and special-category support, with continuation conditions involving attendance, backlogs and conduct. A specific agriculture award requires confirmation.

faqs.question: What training and outcome evidence is available for ITM University?
faqs.answer: The NIRF 2026 agriculture-and-allied return reports 97 placed graduates from 114 four-year undergraduate completers in 2024–25, with 14 selected for higher study. The reported median salary applies to placed graduates in that grouped return.

faqs.question: How can I contact ITM University about an application?
faqs.answer: Published phone: +91-9329934215. Published email: admission@itmuniversity.ac.in. Official admissions: https://www.itmuniversity.ac.in/admission/eligibility

faqs.question: Which dated admission notices are recorded for ITM University?
faqs.answer: No dated admission event is verified in this profile. The official channel is https://www.itmuniversity.ac.in/admission/eligibility; check the notice for the programme and entry year you intend to join.
